messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: If you need to have surgery or any type of x-ray or CT scan using a dye that is injected into your veins, you may need to temporarily stop taking metformin. Be sure your caregivers know ahead of time that you are using this medication.
Tell your doctor if you have ever had:
- kidney disease (your kidney function may need to be checked before you take this medicine);
- high ketone levels in your blood or urine;
- heart disease, congestive heart failure;
- liver disease or liver impairment
- if you also use insulin, or other oral diabetes medications.
You may develop lactic acidosis, a dangerous build-up of lactic acid in your blood. This may be more likely if you have other medical conditions, a severe infection, chronic alcoholism, or if you are 65 or older. Ask your doctor about your risk.
Metformin immediate release tablets should not be given to a child younger than 10 years old.
This medicine should not be used for type 1 diabetes.
Pregnancy:
Triples: [["metformin", "may need to be stopped before", "surgery"], ["metformin", "may need to be stopped before", "x-ray with injected dye"], ["metformin", "may need to be stopped before", "ct scan with injected dye"], ["metformin", "requires patient notification to", "caregivers"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "kidney disease"], ["metformin", "requires kidney function check before use", "kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "high ketone levels"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "heart disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "congestive heart failure"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver impairment"], ["metformin", "use with caution if", "using insulin"], ["metformin", "use with caution if", "using other oral diabetes medications"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "increased risk of lactic acidosis if", "severe infection"], ["metformin", "increased risk of lactic acidosis if", "chronic alcoholism"], ["metformin", "increased risk of lactic acidosis if", "age 65 or older"], ["metformin", "not approved for", "children younger than 10 years old"], ["metformin", "not indicated for", "type 1 diabetes"], ["metformin", "has pregnancy warning", "may harm unborn baby"]]
Relations: ["has pregnancy warning", "has serious side effect", "increased risk of lactic acidosis if", "may need to be stopped before", "not approved for", "not indicated for", "requires kidney function check before use", "requires patient notification to", "use with caution if", "use with caution in"]
Answer:

completion:
has pregnancy warning: The subject medication may pose a risk to the unborn baby and is associated with potential harm during pregnancy.  
has serious side effect: The subject medication may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.  
increased risk of lactic acidosis if: The risk of developing lactic acidosis from the subject medication is higher in individuals with the specified condition or circumstance.  
may need to be stopped before: The subject medication should be temporarily discontinued prior to the specified medical procedure or diagnostic test.  
not approved for: The subject medication is not approved for use in the specified patient population or condition.  
not indicated for: The subject medication is not recommended or appropriate for use in the specified medical condition.  
requires kidney function check before use: Before initiating treatment with the subject medication, kidney function must be assessed in patients with the specified condition.  
requires patient notification to: Patients using the subject medication must inform their caregivers or healthcare providers about its use.  
use with caution if: The subject medication should be used with care or under close medical supervision when the patient is using the specified substance or medication.  
use with caution in: The subject medication may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the specified medical condition.
